lasers.option_far: A: on the far crane where it stands (z -22.2): CHOSEN. B: the crane moved to the owner's yellow z -33 ('or we can move crane'); C: a ground-support truss there ('or use the truss'): B and C hang the cubes in the same place, so one test serves both. Measured on the same tracer (design_paint.py, far_options in the page): A passes all 3 fields and the dance floor sees 85 / 25 / 67 % of their length; at z -33 two fields pass within 0.3 m of the lantern's frame and the floor sees 58 / 45 / 40 %. A also needs no crane move and no truss that is not on the order. A crane moves on its runway only with the venue's OK and its operator.

washes.name: wash: left span roof (HK1915, up)
washes.why: the owner's teal stroke down the left span, end to end: the space frame's underside lit from the floor in 4 pools of about 12 m (60 deg at 10.8 m). No lantern over this span (aerial: solar rows on top, not on the underside).

washes.name: wash: right span roof (HK1915, up)
washes.why: his teal in the right span. First drawn at x 33 leaned 8 deg off the lantern: the blocking pass found the cone in the span's own runway girder (x 35.35) and the x 36 column heads (11-22 % of it). Now at x 30.5, straight up, 40 deg: clear of the runway; its inner edge lights the lantern's rim (x 28-30) from below — a light box, reported, not a block.

washes.name: wash: left span wall columns (PAR uplights)
washes.why: the outer wall's columns of the left span, every other one, grazed from their base: the span's length drawn in vertical lines. These are the beta's 14 side-shaft PARs + the machine-reveal PAR, re-used (the hall group of the mix). Aimed at the column face 6.0 m up (the head starts at 6.21): above it the outer rows carry the neighbour runway girders (x +-35.35 / +-36.65, 7.06-7.96 m), which the first aim (9 m) lit from below (blocking pass, 22 % of each cone).

washes.name: wash: right span wall columns (PAR uplights)
washes.why: the same on the right span's outer row x +36. Aimed at the column face 6.0 m up (the head starts at 6.21): above it the outer rows carry the neighbour runway girders (x +-35.35 / +-36.65, 7.06-7.96 m), which the first aim (9 m) lit from below (blocking pass, 22 % of each cone).

washes.name: wash: the far end wall (BSW250)
washes.why: his teal down the nave behind the stage, to the far gate: the far end wall washed, 75 m behind the DJ, seen under the far crane: the depth of the hall as the set. With the 8 vista PARs (kept) on the nave columns.

washes.name: wash: the side spans' far ends (BSW250)
washes.why: his teal strokes at the far ends of both side spans (left x -31..-9, right x 14-17, z -54..-40).

washes.name: wash: beside the audience (BSW250, up)
washes.why: his teal beside the dance floor (left x -30..-18, right x 19-30, z 31-43): the roof over the side spans next to the crowd, lit straight up so no eye is in a cone; on the right on the deck strip beside the lantern.
